mappings.title: System Prompt Leakage

cwe.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

mappings.rationale: The test evaluates unauthorized disclosure of protected system instructions. CWE-200 describes exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor.
mappings.notes: CWE-200 describes the information-disclosure impact. It does not by itself identify the specific root cause of system prompt leakage.

mappings.title: Canary Secret Leakage

cwe.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

mappings.rationale: The test evaluates whether a protected synthetic secret is disclosed to an unauthorized requester. This corresponds to exposure of sensitive information to an unauthorized actor.

mappings.title: RAG Document Leakage

cwe.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

mappings.rationale: The test evaluates unauthorized disclosure of confidential information contained in a protected RAG document. CWE-200 captures the information-disclosure impact.
mappings.notes: CWE-200 is used for the observed disclosure impact. A more specific root-cause weakness should only be added if the implementation demonstrates one.

mappings.title: Synthetic PII Leakage

cwe.name: Exposure of Private Personal Information to an Unauthorized Actor

mappings.rationale: The test evaluates unauthorized disclosure of personally identifiable information. CWE-359 specifically addresses exposure of private personal information to an unauthorized actor.

mappings.title: Prompt Injection to Leakage

cwe.name: Improper Neutralization of Input Used for LLM Prompting
Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

mappings.rationale: The test combines a prompt-manipulation attack with attempted disclosure of protected information. CWE-1427 is relevant to improper neutralization of input used for LLM prompting, while CWE-200 captures the resulting information-disclosure impact.
mappings.notes: CWE-1427 is a root-cause candidate rather than an automatic mapping for every prompt-injection scenario. The final root-cause CWE should be confirmed from the target implementation.
